input.objective:
Launch imd/acc's StackReceiver on Ethereum mainnet from this repository (the launch-mainnet branch, which is main without .github/workflows; do not add any workflow file): deploy only the StackReceiver, exactly as launch.json lists it, on Ethereum mainnet, wired to the real IMD, the real sIMD vault and LayerZero's endpoint. It is the Ethereum end of imd/acc's multichain route: cashback paid on other chains (Robinhood Chain first) waits in a RemoteStacker there and reaches the trader as staked IMD on Ethereum through IMD's own LayerZero bridge. imd/acc pays trading cashback to traders as staked IMD (sIMD), 0.25% to 1% of each trade at each project's choice, funded from the project's existing fees; only credits from listed projects earn points. The live mainnet Stacker (0x06909f672301f28a810f78cfe7a754851269f4f0, launch #1409) and ProjectRegistry (0x7f53fa1543c682bb5de3f50c2cf3d1842ae57faa, launch #1495) are not redeployed and not touched.

DEPLOY (Ethereum mainnet, one contract):
- StackReceiver(imd, sImd, endpoint) = (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 IMD, 0x9efa934d9fad4ae28c998a40195646b965a97247 sIMD, 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fE728c LayerZero EndpointV2 on Ethereum, eid 30101). launch.json already lists exactly this.
- src/multichain/StackReceiver.sol and src/multichain/LayerZero.sol stay as they are: no owner; the constructor makes no external call. IMD is a standard LayerZero OFT (oftVersion 0x02e49c2c, 1; 6 shared decimals; peered with Robinhood Chain, eid 30416). When a RemoteStacker on another chain flushes waiting cashback, it calls IMD's send with this contract as recipient and a compose message, abi.encode(address[] traders, uint256[] amounts). On Ethereum, IMD's lzReceive mints the amount to this contract and queues the compose at the endpoint; an executor then calls the endpoint's lzCompose, which calls this contract's lzCompose(from, guid, message, executor, extraData). The contract accepts that call only from the endpoint (NotEndpoint) and only with from == IMD (NotIMD); it decodes the OFT compose message (nonce, srcEid, amountLD, composeFrom, composeMsg), requires the listed amounts to add up exactly to amountLD (AmountMismatch) and the two lists to be non-empty and equal in length (BadList), checks sIMD.asset() == IMD and approves the vault once on the first delivery (AssetMismatch), then deposits each amount into sIMD for its trader (Delivered(guid, srcEid, trader, imd, shares)); a deposit the vault refuses or that mints zero shares pays that trader plain IMD instead (DeliveredPlain), so one trader never holds up a delivery. It keeps no IMD after a delivery; deliveredFrom(srcEid) and totalDelivered count the IMD delivered. Whoever sends a message pays out only the IMD that came with it: the amount in the message is written by the IMD token itself, and a sender that lies about its list can only lose its own IMD; composeFrom is not trusted and not needed. nonReentrant; OpenZeppelin SafeERC20.
- The RemoteStacker (src/multichain/RemoteStacker.sol) is the other end, launched later on Robinhood Chain with this contract's address; it is not deployed here.
- test/mocks (MockOFT, MockEndpoint, TestIMD, TestSIMD, MockIntake) and test/trial hold test doubles and trial contracts only. Keep foundry.toml as it is (solc 0.8.26, cancun, 10,000 runs, bytecode_hash none).

FACTS (read on chain 2026-10-13, Ethereum block 26,181,154): IMD's endpoint() is 0x1a44...728c (eid 30101), peers(30416) is Robinhood Chain's IMD 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127, decimalConversionRate 1e12 (amounts cross in steps of 0.000001 IMD), msgInspector none, enforced options only for plain sends (60k gas), so a send-and-call carries its own gas options: the RemoteStacker asks 250,000 for lzReceive and 200,000 + 80,000 per trader for lzCompose. sIMD: owner renounced, not paused. Mainnet fork with the live IMD, vault and endpoint (test/StackReceiverMainnetFork.t.sol, the arrival played exactly as the live contracts do: IMD's lzReceive called by the endpoint, then the endpoint's lzCompose called by an executor): IMD's lzReceive uses 98k gas for one trader and 158k for fifty; the compose delivery 225k for one trader, 685k for ten and 3.08M for fifty, within the budget above; a second delivery of the same compose is refused by the endpoint; the receiver's runtime is 4,154 bytes.

TESTS: forge test passes (292 tests: 270 run offline; 20 fork tests run when ETH_RPC_URL, SEPOLIA_RPC_URL and ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL are set; 2 Stacker-manifest checks skip because this launch.json lists the receiver). test/StackReceiver.t.sol (the checks, deposits, the paused-vault fallback, stray IMD never spent), test/MultichainFlow.t.sol (the whole route through the mocks, with the invariants that the RemoteStacker holds exactly what is waiting and the receiver keeps nothing), test/StackReceiverMainnetFork.t.sol (the live contracts), test/Deployment.t.sol (this manifest, the empty-chain rehearsal, EIP-170 and forbidden opcodes). Keep all of them passing.
